summary: MasTec Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a $700 million senior unsecured delayed draw term loan agreement with Bank of America as administrative agent, composed of a $400 million three-year tranche and a $300 million four-year tranche. Borrowings will finance a portion of consideration for an acquisition and related fees; the commitments terminate if the acquisition does not close. Interest is based on Term SOFR or Base Rate plus margins ranging from 0.000% to 1.625%. This filing solely describes financing arrangements and does not announce or constitute a special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review.
